patch_description:
This crossover keeps the stronger random-without-replacement lookahead sampling strategy from the best-scoring prior implementation, while adopting the compact flat `uint8_t` board representation and allocation-free tilt operations from the faster inspiration program.

Key improvements:
- Flat 100-cell board makes copying and tilt simulation substantially cheaper.
- No dynamic candy list rebuilds after every simulated tilt.
- Distinct random placement ranks prevent duplicated chance-node samples.
- Uses 20/7 samples thanks to the lighter board implementation.
- Preserves connectivity, center-of-mass, strip, and edge shaping terms from the better-performing policy.
- At a full board, evaluates only the true component-square objective, avoiding heuristic distortion during final decisions.
